case_title: NIAO QUAN CHEN ET AL VS. CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY CHEN, NIAO QUAN ZENG, YUE AS TO DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-10-2023 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVICE FEE $50. SERVED JUL-14-2023, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-10-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-10-2023 BY JUDGE PRO TEM PANG LY. PLAINTIFF NIAO QUAN CHEN IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF YUE ZENG IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFFS ARE ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER JEFF DINN VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY ZOE GRIMALDI, INTER, GRACE GLENN, CLAIM ADJUSTER, MARLEEN GREENE, CLAIM ADJUSTER.. DEFENDANTS WAIVE SERVICE ISSUES. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-10-2023 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CHEN, NIAO QUAN ZENG, YUE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO PLAINTIFFS WERE IN A LEFT TURN LANE AND FAILED TO TURN LEFT. INSTEAD PROCEEDING FORWARD TO CAUSE IMPACT WITH BUS STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
